title: The Moon as an anomalous alien spacecraft (unreleased Decatur interview)

tellings.quote: a lot of it was around how the moon is possibly this anomalous like alien spacecraft.

plain: The Moon may be an unusual alien spacecraft rather than a natural body. Michels says much of an interview he recorded in 2023 in Decatur, near Atlanta, with the researcher Randall Carlson was about this idea, and that it was never released. If true, it would mean something artificial has been orbiting Earth all along.
